questions: Do you have trouble controlling the movement of your hands, like shaking or unsteady motions, when trying to do tasks like writing or reaching?
Does this hand movement problem happen more when your hands are at rest, or when you're actively using them?
Have you noticed any stiffness in your arms or hands that limits how well you can move them?
Do you find it difficult to start moving your hands or arms once they have been still for a moment?
Did these issues with your hands develop slowly over weeks or months, rather than appearing suddenly?
Do you have any issues with balance, like feeling unsteady when walking or standing?
Has your ability to write, like the spiral you made, gotten worse over time, or do you find it harder to make smooth, controlled lines?
Are the movement problems the same in both hands, or is one hand more affected than the other?
